```{r}
library(gt)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
d_s <- read_excel("../../studierende-uebersicht.xlsx", sheet = "Studierende")
d_g <- read_excel("../../studierende-uebersicht.xlsx", sheet = "Gruppen")
d_t <- read_excel("../../studierende-uebersicht.xlsx", sheet = "Themen")

d <- left_join(d_s, left_join(d_g, d_t, by = "thema"), by = "gruppe") |>
    add_count(gruppe, name = "n_gruppe") |>
    drop_na(nummer_mdl)
```

Liste Termine

```{r}
d |>
    select(nummer_mdl, name, n_gruppe, gruppe, titel_kurz) |>
    arrange(nummer_mdl) |>
    gt()
```

```{=typst}
#let linie(breite) = box(width: breite, stroke: (bottom: 0.5pt), height: 0.8em)

#let protokoll(

) = [

      inset: (x: 0pt, y: 3pt),
      column-gutter: 1em,

    )

  #let kasten(hoehe, inhalt) = block(width: 100%, height: hoehe, stroke: 1pt, inset: 6pt, inhalt)

  #kasten(1fr)[

    #table(

      [*1*], [#frage_1],

    )
  ]
  #kasten(3fr)[
    #text(size: 12pt, weight: "bold")[Frage aus Katalog -- Thema: #if aufgabe == "" [#linie(6cm)] else [#aufgabe] #h(1em) Nr.: #linie(1.5cm)]
  ]
  #kasten(3cm)[*Bewertung*]
]
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
typ_str <- function(x, na = "–") {
    x <- ifelse(is.na(x), na, as.character(x))
    x <- gsub("\\", "\\\\", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x <- gsub("\"", "\\\"", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x <- gsub("\n", "\\n", x, fixed = TRUE)
    paste0("\"", x, "\"")
}

n_max <- max(d_s$n_vorlesungen, na.rm = TRUE)

d |>
    arrange(nummer_mdl) |>
    mutate(n_vorlesungen = if_else(is.na(n_vorlesungen), NA, paste0(n_vorlesungen, " / ", n_max))) |>
    pwalk(\(...) {
        r <- list(...)
        args <- c(
            typ_str(r$nummer_mdl), typ_str(r$vorname), typ_str(r$name),
            typ_str(r$gruppe), typ_str(r$titel_lang),
            typ_str(r$aufgabe, na = ""), typ_str(r$sloc), typ_str(r$n_vorlesungen),
            typ_str(r$s1), typ_str(r$s2), typ_str(r$s3), typ_str(r$kommentar),
            typ_str(r$frage_1, na = ""), typ_str(r$frage_2, na = "")
        )
        cat("\n```{=typst}\n#protokoll(", paste(args, collapse = ", "), ")\n```\n")
    })
```
